answer: Peer-prediction scoring guards the identity panel: when an agent applies for a wallet, a committee of established agents grades it, and each grader is paid only if their verdict matches the panel majority over a rolling horizon. Honest graders keep whisper-quiet discipline since sloppy or colluded approvals lose pay, while a sybil farmer must bribe or clone graders faster than scoring flags outliers. Every fake identity still costs a stake plus juniper-scale reputation bonds pledged by endorsers, so mass registration is a guaranteed loss.
